routing_warnings.description: The unresolved fit, countersinks, and assembly method concern the independent bushing-guidance and retention behavior.
This source describes a preliminary drawing used to verify dimensions rather than implementation of the editable 3D model.
The source establishes several independent mechanical-design changes, principally main-shaft geometry, rather than changing the 3D-model deliverable itself.
The bushing location, rod-guidance function, and clearance specification belong to the bushing Requirement.
The client changes the bushing retention and sliding arrangement, an independent mechanical behavior.
The color and black-and-white versions concern drawing presentation.
The color treatment of drawing views belongs to drawing visual presentation; the requested output formats belong to the separate file-format Requirement.
The source claims availability of exchange and editable native file formats rather than implementation of model geometry.
The confirmed PDF, DWG, STEP, and editable SolidWorks outputs belong to the file-format Requirement.
The corrected shaft-blank reference dimensions concern drawing annotations rather than the 3D assembly model.
The instruction to keep only 3D views colored and make all other views black-and-white changes drawing presentation rather than drawing-set completeness.
The requests for PDF, DWG/DXF, STEP, and editable native files belong to the delivery-format Requirement.
The instructions to add the functional hole distance and bracket the overall length concern technical drawing annotations.
The confirmed PDF, DWG, STEP, and editable SolidWorks outputs concern delivery formats.
The corrected shaft-blank reference dimensions concern drawing annotations rather than completeness of the drawing set.
The unresolved length and fit question concerns the bushing relative to its shaft seat rather than independently changing main-shaft geometry.
The H8/h9 clearance and guidance behavior are owned by the narrower bushing-guidance Requirement.
The reported missing keyway is explicitly on the sliding mandrel, not the main shaft.
The commitment to add the missing keyway addresses the sliding-mandrel Requirement.
The fix concerns incorrectly associated reference dimensions on the shaft-blank drawing rather than a change to the shaft's physical geometry.
